item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q007_chey_like_function_divergence","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 supports remote homology at the CheY-like superfamily level: all three belong to alpha/beta class c, flavodoxin-like fold c.23, and CheY-like superfamily c.23.1 (SUNID 52172). They are nevertheless separate families: CheY-related c.23.1.1 (SUNID 52173), ornithine-decarboxylase N-terminal “wing” c.23.1.4 (SUNID 52252), and KaiA N-terminal domain c.23.1.5 (SUNID 82344). Thus common ancestry and a related structural core are supported, but close family-level equivalence is not. One must not transfer CheY-like phosphoacceptor/two-component or chemotaxis signaling to the ODC wing or KaiA domain; SCOPe specifically notes that the KaiA family lacks canonical receiver-domain features. Nor does the small ODC wing establish PLP binding, decarboxylase catalysis, or substrate specificity, which belong to the complete enzyme and its catalytic domain. Conversely, neither the CheY-related domain nor ODC wing can be assigned KaiA circadian regulation or Kai-protein interactions from this superfamily placement. Cross-family structures may serve as remote fold templates, not as functional or active-site templates; representatives should preferentially match the same family and domain architecture. Functional transfer would require family-resolved sequence and active-site conservation plus external biochemical evidence—phosphotransfer assays for receiver signaling, enzyme/PLP assays for ODC catalysis, or Kai interaction and clock/genetic assays for KaiA function.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__search_scop","mcp__scope__get_scop_node","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.23.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.23.1/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/homology"]}]}
